messages:
nisha: Heads-up: prod-euc1 GPU warm pool nodes failing final attestation & getting ejected. Symptoms: hsm-proxy 403, kms:Decrypt denied, ENI attach timeouts.

infra-bot: ALERT 1768765432 - warm-pool-join fail x9 in prod-euc1. Errors: KMS_GRANT_EXPIRED, eni_attach_timeout, FW DROP to audit-shipper.svc.internal:443.

david: Looked into key-rotation logs: key alias/infra-hsm rotated; grant gr-2026euc shows expiry 2026-03-23T01:12:00Z. Allocator sessions still reference old grant.

karim: FW change note: policy FW-REGION-STRICT merged yesterday restricted egress to internal endpoints. Flow logs show src=eni-0a1b2c dst=10.240.5.12 proto=6 action=DROP (audit-shipper). Two separate failures colliding.

nisha: Short-term options: A) issue 1h KMS grant scoped to allocator principal + ephemeral allow to audit-shipper from prod-euc1 NAT CIDR; B) revert firewall rule for audit-shipper (risky); C) manual fallback to prod-usw1 (costly). Thoughts?

claire: Security OK for (A) with conditions: 1) grant TTL 1h programmatic; 2) grant scoped to arn:aws:iam::123456:role/infra-allocator + HSM resource; 3) grant creation event logged to secure audit S3; 4) two-person approval (infra + sec); 5) automated revoke at TTL. Approve if script enforces these constraints.

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-20260323-09 created, priority=P1, owner=nisha, sec-approver=claire.

david: I'll prepare a minimal terraform patch + grant script. Plan:
- terraform patch to add ephemeral SG rule: allow egress to audit-shipper IPs from prod-euc1 NAT CIDR (1h TTL via lifecycle tag)
- aws kms create-grant with Constraints for encryptionContext and grantee principal; capture GrantId and log to S3
- background job to revoke grant after 1h (aws kms revoke-grant)

karim: Cost note for (C): fallback to prod-usw1 for 9 nodes ~1.8TB/day => ~$280/day egress; warmup tail latency +450ms. Keep fallback manual for now.

nisha: Running grant+ephemeral allow now. Command I'm executing (sanitized):
```
# create scoped grant
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/infra-hsm --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/infra-allocator --operations Decrypt --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset":{"purpose":"hsm-attest"}}' --name ephemeral-warmup-grant > /tmp/grant.json
# patch SG (terraform targeting)
terraform apply -target=aws_security_group_rule.euc1-audit-allow -var='env=prod-euc1'
```

infra-bot: UPDATE: grant created grantId=gr-2026euc-ephemeral; terraform apply succeeded; requeueing nodes. Progress: joined 4/9, 5 retrying.

claire: Confirmed audit: creation logged to s3://secure-audit/prod-euc1/2026-03-23/grants/gr-2026euc-ephemeral.json. Two-person approval recorded via approvals service. Good.

david: Adding automated revoke job: lambda scheduled in 60 minutes to run aws kms revoke-grant --grant-id gr-2026euc-ephemeral --key-id alias/infra-hsm and remove the SG rule. Patch referencing tag ttl=60m so ops-bot can alert if revoke fails.

nisha: Nodes stabilized: warm pool rebalanced; final status: 9/9 joined. Marking incident monitor window 2h.

karim: Follow-ups: (1) ensure allocator sessions refresh on key rotation (session token refresh on key-rotation webhook); (2) add e2e test for attestation path that simulates grant rotation; (3) review FW-REGION-STRICT rule to ensure it includes audit-shipper endpoints. I'll open PRs for these.

claire: We'll schedule a brief postmortem if similar incidents recur. For now, close P1 when automated revoke completes and 2h monitor passes.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: revoke scheduled at 2026-03-23T02:12:00Z. Will alert on failure.
